title: Introduction · I open the source first

scenes.line: People make AI sound complicated. That's usually the pitch.
scenes.cue: Flat, unhurried. Land 'the pitch' and stop. Do not sell the line.

scenes.line: I'm AC. I explain AI in plain English.
scenes.cue: Warmest line in the read. This is the handshake.

scenes.line: We checked fourteen free AI tools. Six were trials.
scenes.cue: Say the numbers plainly. Small pause before 'six'.

scenes.line: Every number I put on screen, I open the source first.
scenes.cue: The spine of the whole page. Slow, no lift at the end.

scenes.line: One real trend a day. No hype. No jargon.
scenes.cue: Slowest line in the read. Three separate beats, full stops between.
